depthColors.name: scrim
depthColors.purpose: Backdrop behind overlays (zone browser, hotkey reference).

depthColors.name: shadow
depthColors.purpose: Under the drawer and the event picker.

depthColors.name: shadow-strong
depthColors.purpose: Under menus, overlay panels and lifted cards.

display.purpose: The wordmark only (title-bar h1 and the share image's PROVING GROUNDS mark).

headline.purpose: Largest figures: scorecard metric values, seat commander damage, the library count, the verdict word.

title.purpose: Seat life (22px) and YOU slot values (19px); steps down in narrow and short windows.

body.purpose: Prose, prompts, answer buttons; 12px for captions, logs, tables and the legal line.

label.purpose: Every block title, slot label, zone head and table head; chips at 0.12em, foot tabs at 0.1em.

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: The readout's foot drawer rising over the scroll region.

shadows.name: picker
shadows.purpose: The event dock's card picker hanging over the battlefield.

shadows.name: menu
shadows.purpose: Fixed-position pop menus on cards and stacks.

shadows.name: overlay-panel
shadows.purpose: Zone browser and hotkey reference over the scrim.

shadows.name: hand-hover
shadows.purpose: Hovered card in the hand, with translateY(-8px) scale(1.06).

shadows.name: ring-accent
shadows.purpose: Commander ring and keyboard focus on a card.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Readout values settle on turn advance from opacity 0.3 / translateY(3px); staggered 60ms (YOU) and 120ms (pinned foot); replayed by alternating data-settle='a'|'b'.

motion.name: dock-in
motion.purpose: A new active event fades in from opacity 0 / translateY(-6px).

motion.name: state-fade
motion.purpose: Border, shadow, colour and transform transitions on drop targets, hand hover lift, tapped rotation, history caret.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce -> animation: none; transition: none
motion.purpose: Every animation and transition is disabled by name; the settled state reads the same.

breakpoints.name: readout-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Right rail 320 -> 280px; seat 'life' caption folds; chips tighten; figures step to 20/17px.

breakpoints.name: readout-narrower
breakpoints.purpose: Right rail -> 250px (276px if also under 820px tall); zone stacks shrink to 78px.

breakpoints.name: strip-scroll
breakpoints.purpose: Bottom strip scrolls horizontally instead of clipping; stacks 70px, slots 58x81.

breakpoints.name: shorter
breakpoints.purpose: Title bar 38px; readout figures 18/16px; tabs 30px; legal line 11px. 768px is the floor held.

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: The play-surface button: square, transparent, printed-rule border. Used for turn actions and event responses.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 4px 8px; font: 13px/1.35 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #e8e6e1); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #6a6d77); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent, #c9a85c); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c9a85c); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; } .ds-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 4px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #6a6d77); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted, #a0a3aa); }

components.name: Primary Answer
components.description: The event's key-1 response: the one button wearing the accent. Label clamps to two lines.
components.css: .ds-btn-answer { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 7px; padding: 4px 9px 4px 5px; font: 13px/1.35 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-align: left; color: var(--ink, #e8e6e1); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #c9a85c); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-answer:hover:not(:disabled) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #c9a85c) 12%, transparent); } .ds-btn-answer:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c9a85c); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-answer-label { display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 4px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #6a6d77); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted, #a0a3aa); } .ds-key-accent { border-color: var(--accent, #c9a85c); color: var(--accent, #c9a85c); }

components.name: Filled Primary
components.description: The deck rail's Start-run button, the only filled control. Ink is the ground token so it inverts with the theme.
components.css: .ds-btn-filled { padding: 5px 10px; font: 600 13px/1.35 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ground, #17181c); background: var(--accent, #c9a85c); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #c9a85c); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-filled:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-filled:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c9a85c); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-filled:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; }

components.name: State Chip
components.description: A word inside a printed-rule border. OUT, CLOCK, ARMED stay muted; HIT is the only accent chip; the event class chip wears its mana colour.
components.html: Clock Hit Combat
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--pgp-accent, var(--rule, #6a6d77)); border-radius: 0; font: 500 11px/1.2 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--pgp-accent, var(--muted, #a0a3aa)); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-hit { border-color: var(--accent, #c9a85c); color: var(--accent, #c9a85c); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Ground-filled field with a printed-rule border (3:1 control edge) and the accent focus ring. Numeric fields are right-aligned and tabular.
components.css: .ds-field { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font: 500 11px/1.2 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #a0a3aa); } .ds-input { width: 62px; min-height: 25px; padding: 3px 6px; font: 13px/1.35 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; color: var(--ink, #e8e6e1); background: var(--ground, #17181c); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #6a6d77); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c9a85c); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Foot Tabs
components.description: The readout's on-demand tab row: equal tabs, hairline between, the open tab underlined in ink.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button class="ds-tab ds-tab-open">Log</button><button class="ds-tab">Notes</button><button class="ds-tab">Tokens</button><button class="ds-tab">Keys</button><button class="ds-tab">End run</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; height: 34px; width: 320px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #33353c); background: var(--ground, #17181c); } .ds-tab { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; padding: 0 2px; font: 500 11px/1.2 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; color: var(--muted, #a0a3aa); background: transparent; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--line, #33353c); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #e8e6e1); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #c9a85c); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tab-open { color: var(--ink, #e8e6e1); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--ink, #e8e6e1); }

components.name: Printed Slot
components.description: The unit of every reading: a printed label over a tabular figure, ruled off above. Two to a line in YOU; the scorecard's metric slots are the same element at 24px.
components.html:

Hand1

components.css: .ds-pairs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; width: 292px; padding: 6px 14px 7px; background: var(--ground, #17181c); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-pair { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 50%; min-width: 0; padding: 3px 0 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #33353c); } .ds-pairs > .ds-pair:nth-child(1), .ds-pairs > .ds-pair:nth-child(2) { padding-top: 0; border-top: 0; } .ds-pair-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #a0a3aa); } .ds-pair-value { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.005em; color: var(--ink, #e8e6e1); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-pair-sub { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--muted, #a0a3aa); }

components.name: Seat Row
components.description: One seat in SEATS: letter and life, chips, a ten-segment printed threat meter with numeral and trend word. The eliminated variant keeps its slot with a rule drawn through the top line.
components.html:
C40LifeHit
Threat4rising
B0LifeOut
components.css: .ds-seat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 292px; padding: 3px 0 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #33353c); background: var(--ground, #17181c); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-seat:first-child { border-top: 0; } .ds-seat-line { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; } .ds-seat-id { flex: none; width: 13px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: var(--muted, #a0a3aa); } .ds-seat-life { flex: none; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--ink, #e8e6e1); } .ds-seat-cap { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #a0a3aa); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-seat-chips { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-left: auto; } .ds-chip { padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #6a6d77); border-radius: 0; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #a0a3aa); } .ds-chip-hit { border-color: var(--accent, #c9a85c); color: var(--accent, #c9a85c); } .ds-meter { display: flex; gap: 3px; flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 40px; } .ds-meter i { flex: 1 1 0; height: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #6a6d77); } .ds-meter i.on { background: var(--ink, #e8e6e1); border-color: var(--ink, #e8e6e1); } .ds-seat-num { min-width: 13px; text-align: right; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #e8e6e1); } .ds-seat-trend { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted, #a0a3aa); } .ds-seat-out { opacity: 0.6; } .ds-seat-out .ds-seat-top::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 0; right: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #6a6d77); pointer-events: none; }

narrative.overview:
Proving Grounds is a solo Commander playtest trainer. Its readout is a pilot's kneeboard, not an instrument panel: pre-printed small-caps labels sit in the same place every turn, and the current figures are written into them in large tabular numerals. Blocks are separated by hairline rules across the full width of the sheet, never boxed; the sheet fills the column top to bottom in the order the pilot looks (seats, own numbers, tells, the event waiting for an answer). Card faces from Scryfall are the only imagery and they are never filtered, tinted, or framed beyond a 1px hairline.

The surface is ink on matte. Dark ships by default; light is the same design with swapped token values and is selected by `data-theme="light"` on the root element. Nothing glows, blooms, bevels, or textures. One warm accent is held back for whatever needs an answer now: the seat to hit and the active event's primary response. Everything else is stated in ink and muted ink, and every state is a printed word inside a border, so it survives greyscale and forced colours.

The build refused two things by name and the refusal is durable: the three-column admin shell (seats as sidebar cards, metrics as KPI tiles), and rendered instruments (gauges, needles, lamps, dials, drawn card backs). The threat meter is ten printed segments, filled or outlined, not a dial. An eliminated seat keeps its row and takes a rule through it, so the scan never changes.
keyCharacteristics: Printed label over tabular figure is the unit of every reading, on the readout and on the scorecard alike.
Ruled rows, not boxes: `border-top` or `border-bottom` hairlines carry structure; fills and four-sided borders are reserved for floating layers and the between-runs rail.
One grotesk (IBM Plex Sans 400/500/600) for every heading, figure and label; the serif display face (Marcellus) exists in the wordmark only.
Dark default, light as a pure token swap, including scrim and shadow colours.
Square chips and key squares on the play surface; 6px radius only on panels, menus and pickers that float.
Motion is a 240ms settle on turn advance and 110-140ms fades elsewhere, every one of them disabled under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Token Swap Rule
rules.body: Light is not a redesign. Every colour, including scrims and shadows, is a custom property with a value in both theme blocks; no literal hex, rgb or rgba appears in component CSS, and the share image reads the same custom properties at render time. Transparent black is not theme-neutral.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: `accent` is spent on what needs an answer now (HIT, the active event's head and primary response) and on interaction affordances (focus, hover border, drop target, commander ring). It is not a chart series, not a heading colour, not a second chip on the same seat row. CLOCK and ARMED print in `rule`.

rules.name: The Word Inside a Border Rule
rules.body: No state is carried by colour alone. A chip is a word with a border; a trend prints "rising"; the threat meter is filled versus outlined; an answered event is struck through. Colour underlines the word, never replaces it.

rules.name: The Wordmark-Only Rule
rules.body: Marcellus appears on exactly one element in the app and one line of the share image. Every heading, figure and verdict is IBM Plex Sans.

rules.name: The Tabular Figure Rule
rules.body: Every number sits in a printed slot and must not change width as it ticks; tabular lining numerals are set at the root and never overridden. The share image's canvas uses the same face for the same reason.

rules.name: The Printed Label Rule
rules.body: A label is 11px / 500 / 0.16em / uppercase / muted, above the value it names. Labels are the world's native device (a kneeboard's pre-printed slot names), not decoration: a label exists only where a figure or block needs naming.

rules.name: The Only Floating Things Cast Shadows Rule
rules.body: A surface that sits in the layout has a rule, not a shadow. A surface that is positioned over the table has a shadow from the vocabulary above and nothing else.

rules.name: The Settle Rule
rules.body: On turn advance the readout's values settle in reading order: 240ms `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` from 0.3 opacity and 3px down, staggered 60ms (YOU) and 120ms (pinned foot), replayed by alternating `data-settle` between two identical keyframe names. A new event fades in over 140ms ease-out; drop targets, hover lifts and the history caret transition in 110-120ms ease. Every animation and transition is disabled by name under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, and the settled state reads the same without it.

dos: Do set every reading as a printed slot: label at 11px / 500 / 0.16em uppercase muted, figure at 19px or larger at 600, ruled off above by a 1px `line`.
Do separate blocks and rows with one hairline on one side; a surface in the layout has a rule, not a box.
Do keep chips, key squares and readout buttons square with a 1px `rule` border; keep the 6px radius for panels, menus and pickers.
Do print the word for every state (OUT, HIT, rising, struck-through) and let colour underline it.
Do spend `accent` on the one thing that needs an answer and on focus, hover and drop affordances only.
Do declare every colour, including scrims and shadows, in `tokens.css` with a value in both theme blocks, and use `color-mix()` for tints.
Do hold pointer targets to 24px on the height axis with padding and negative margin, leaving the printed size alone.
Do disable every animation and transition by name under `prefers-reduced-motion`, and make sure the settled state reads the same.
Do keep the hand visible at every width and the board above 260px of card width; narrow the readout first.
donts: Don't use Marcellus anywhere but the wordmark; headings, verdicts and figures are IBM Plex Sans.
Don't draw instruments: no gauges, needles, lamps, dials, hatched card backs or rendered props. A meter is filled-or-outlined segments.
Don't add glow, bloom, bevels, neon, gradients, textures or paper; no `filter` or `backdrop-filter` on any surface, and never on a card face.
Don't box a metric: no KPI tiles with fill, four-sided border and radius on the scorecard or the readout.
Don't dim `muted` further with opacity; the token clears AA at full strength and loses it when multiplied.
Don't put a literal hex, rgb or rgba in component CSS, or fork the palette into a script; read the custom properties.
Don't give a seat a second accent chip; CLOCK and ARMED print in `rule`.
Don't make `danger` and `mana-r` the same hue; a life loss and a combat event must read as different signals.
Don't add clicks or modal interruptions to the play loop, or hide the hand to make room.
